items.title: Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11
items.title_zh: Python 3.15 发布，PEP 810 显式惰性导入正式落地
items.title_en: Python 3.15 Arrives with PEP 810 Explicit Lazy Imports
items.summary: Simon Willison reviews Python 3.15's release, highlighting PEP 810 explicit lazy imports and the shift from supporting Python 3.10 to embracing Python 3.11 features.

items.title: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型生成的数学成果合集  OpenAI 发布由内部未公开前沿模型生成的数学成果，GitHub 合集含 722 篇手稿、372 个结果系
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型生成的数学成果合集
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases Math Results From Internal Frontier Model
items.summary: OpenAI released a GitHub collection of mathematical results produced by an internal unreleased frontier model, featuring 722 manuscripts and 372 result series on long-unsolved problems, many verified in Lean.

items.title: Hackers activate automatic defrosting in supermarket fridges across Europe
items.title_zh: 黑客远程触发欧洲超市冷柜化霜，冷藏系统大面积瘫痪
items.title_en: Hackers Trigger Defrost Cycles in European Supermarket Fridges
items.summary: A cyberattack disrupted supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe by remotely triggering defrost cycles, exposing systemic vulnerabilities in internet-connected legacy OT/control equipment.

items.title: Turn a WiFi 7 Router into a 320Msps Software Defined Radio Receiver
items.title_zh: WiFi 7 路由器被改装为 320 Msps 软件定义无线电接收机
items.title_en: WiFi 7 Router Repurposed as a 320 Msps Software Defined Radio Receiver
items.summary: A developer demonstrates turning a WiFi 7 router into a 320 Msps software defined radio receiver, sparking technical discussion on cheap SDR applications and hardware reuse.

items.title: Codex CLI installs a persistent, self-updating background daemon by default
items.title_zh: Codex CLI 默认安装常驻自更新的后台守护进程
items.title_en: Codex CLI installs a persistent, self-updating background daemon by default
items.summary: OpenAI's Codex CLI installs a persistent, self-updating background daemon by default, sparking community discussion about undocumented configuration, resource usage, and bugs.

items.title: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly
items.title_zh: Show HN：PS2 游戏被静态重编译为 WebAssembly，可在浏览器中运行
items.title_en: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly for the browser
items.summary: A project that statically recompiles PS2 games to WebAssembly, enabling browser-based play, with community discussion on security, recompilation, and related efforts.

items.title: Looped Diffusion Transformer: the same blocks run several times inside each denoising step, and loop depth can be changed at sampling time [R]
items.title_zh: 循环扩散Transformer：在每个去噪步内重复运行共享模块
items.title_en: Looped Diffusion Transformer Reuses Shared Blocks Inside Each Denoising Step
items.summary: A Reddit post discusses a Looped Diffusion Transformer that reuses shared blocks multiple times per denoising step, achieving better efficiency than larger models and allowing loop depth to be adjusted at sampling time.

items.title: learnc: fit the constants in existing C code to data (9.1% smaller JPEGs, +4.9 F1 on WebRTC VAD) [P]
items.title_zh: learnc 自动调优现有 C 代码常量，JPEG 体积缩小 9.1%
items.title_en: learnc Auto-Tunes Constants in Existing C Code, Shrinking JPEGs 9.1%
items.summary: learnc is an MIT-licensed tool that tunes constants in existing C source code against a C score function, achieving 9.1% smaller JPEGs and +4.9 F1 on WebRTC VAD on held-out data.
